summary: T069 deliverable is complete. The orchestrator module (src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py) owns the durable product-run lifecycle (run request, run state, RunStateStore, CancelToken, BacktestOrchestrator, EventSource / DatasetResolver / DatasetCoverage protocols, product rerun, restart-in-flight resume). The CLI (backtest start / list / observe / cancel / resume) wires the orchestrator with a CLI-supplied dataset registry and a synthetic empty event source so every subcommand is reproducible without a Web process. The test suite (tests/test_backtest_t069.py) covers every acceptance clause: registry-bound manifest publication, two heterogeneous pools sharing dataset / numeraire / qualification, byte-equivalent re-running, product rerun leaving the source byte-identical, cancellation / unknown strategy identity / missing dataset / block range outside coverage / legacy source failing closed, atomic and immutable RunStateStore, restart-while-running neither duplicating nor losing state, no credentials in the run record, and CLI subcommands working without a Web process. Ruff, mypy, the import-layer check, the acceptance checker, and the citation checker all pass; the full pytest suite (excluding the forge-dependent oracle test that fails due to missing Solidity lib in this worktree) is green (2685 passed, 6 skipped).
